cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
cat /proc/uptime
dmesg | awk '/ERR DET Status|GetErrDetStatus|ERR DET Status Debug|RT Protect/ {buf[n%32]=$0; n++} END {start=n>32?n-32:0; for(i=start;i<n;i++) print buf[i%32]; print "FILTER_MATCH_COUNT",n+0}'
cat /proc/uptime
